description: Biomethane Potential in Colorado 2014 is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Information about the Biomethane resources generated for Colorado Counties by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and verified annually. Navigate to NREL source for most current information. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are potential, renewable energy, nrel, natural resources, bic. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2015-02-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
